subject: [PATCH v4 1/3] mm: zswap: use separate compression and decompression requests

2026-10-17.patch_summary: This patch separates the compression and decompression requests in the zswap module, allowing them to run independently and reducing contention between high-priority loads and low-priority stores. This is done by introducing new data structures for compression and decompression contexts, which are synchronized internally by the codecs and drivers. The change also reduces memory usage on x86-64 systems without PREEMPT_RT or lock debugging. The patch was proposed based on a similar split for zram and has been reviewed and acknowledged by multiple developers.
